mapper.select: SELECT application_user_id AS user_id , user_name AS employee_no , NVL(full_name_local,english_full_name) AS employee_name , system_code , module_code , role_code , role_name , TO_CHAR(apply_start_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_start_date , TO_CHAR(apply_end_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_end_date , approver_opinion_desc FROM LGCOM_USER_ROLE_N_V WHERE application_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY system_code, module_code, role_code
mapper.update: MERGE INTO LGCOM_USER_ROLE_N a USING ( SELECT #{userId} AS application_user_id , #{roleCode} AS role_code , TO_DATE(#{applyStartDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_start_date , TO_DATE(#{applyEndDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_end_date , #{approverOpinionDesc} AS approver_opinion_desc , #{sessionUserId} AS sess_user_id FROM DUAL ) b ON (a.application_user_id = b.application_user_id AND a.role_code = b.role_code) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET apply_start_date = b.apply_start_date , apply_end_date = b.apply_end_date , approver_opinion_desc = b.approver_opinion_desc , last_updated_by = b.sess_user_id , last_update_date = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( application_user_id,role_code,apply_start_date,apply_end_date,approver_opinion_desc, created_by,creation_date,last_updated_by,last_update_date ) VALUES( b.application_user_id,b.role_code,b.apply_start_date,b.apply_end_date,b.approver_opinion_desc, b.sess_user_id,SYSDATE,b.sess_user_id,SYSDATE )
